- Role: Software Engineer — Level L4 (IC)
- Base: $160,000
- Target annual bonus: 10%
- RSU grant (4-yr): 0.08% (time-vested) — estimate ~$25k/year value
- Total cash + equity TCE: ~ $190k first year

Attachments: ana_fernandez_comp_proposal.xlsx (detailed compsheet + benchmark).

Notes / constraints: hiring manager requests start date for conversion 2026-07-06 if approved. We have an open headcount ticket HC-1245 in Jira (link below) but need People Ops and Finance sign-off on the exact band/equity.

Can you review and advise — specifically whether this sits in L4 band and whether Finance can approve the incremental headcount cost?

Thanks,
Aditya
